name: iam:PassRole + glue:CreateSession + glue:RunStatement
description: Create a Glue Interactive Session with a privileged role passed via iam:PassRole, then run inline Python via glue:RunStatement. The boto3 client in the session automatically uses the passed role's credentials — no S3 script or job definition required.
author: Seth Art

admin: IAM role with administrative permissions and trust policy allowing glue.amazonaws.com
lateral: IAM role trusting glue.amazonaws.com with elevated permissions

references.title: Interactive sessions with IAM - AWS Glue
Getting started with AWS Glue interactive sessions

options.name: ROLE_ARN
options.description: IAM role ARN to pass to the Glue Interactive Session (must trust glue.amazonaws.com)

options.name: REGION
options.description: AWS region for the Glue Interactive Session

options.name: SESSION_ID
options.description: Glue Interactive Session ID (auto-generated if not set)

options.name: CLEANUP
options.description: Delete the Glue Interactive Session after execution (requires glue:DeleteSession)
